report: Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı hafif derecede artmış. Ön çapraz bağın tibyaya yapışma kesimindeki subkortikal kemik iliği ödemi kontüzyon ile uyumlu. Bu kesimde ön çapraz bağın lifleri arasındaki sıvı sinyali parsiyel yırtığı telkin ediyor. Lateral femoral kondilin posteriorundaki subkortikal kemik iliği ödemi kontüzyon ile uyumlu. Arka çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları korunmuş. Medyal menisküs ve lateral menisküs normal. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler bunların dışında normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş (kuadriseps tendonu ve patellar tendon, patella ve yerleşimi, femoral troklear oluk ve patellofemoral bağlar normal).

There is a fairly extensive albeit undisplaced undersurface horizontal tear through the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with no significant medial extrusion being noted in the level of the body, nor is there any posterior root involvement.
A grade 1 superficial MCL sprain is nonetheless present.

Intact lateral meniscus, cruciate and lateral collateral ligaments, popliteus musculotendinous unit, extensor tendons and distal iliotibial band.

No fracture or marrow infiltration.

Well-maintained tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage surfaces.
Tiny suprapatellar effusion, no loose bodies are present.
Grossly unremarkable imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication:  Knee pain.. 
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:  Multiplanar and multisequence MRI of the right  knee without IV contrast.   

FINDINGS: 

JOINT EFFUSION:  Moderate knee joint effusion. Small popliteal cyst. 

ANTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT:  Intact. 

POSTERIOR CRUCIATE LIGAMENT:  Intact. 

MEDIAL MENISCUS: Intact. 

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:  Within normal limits. 

LATERAL MENISCUS:  Diminutive appearance of the posterior body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus suggestive of large radial tear in the absence of previous meniscectomy.

The meniscal body also demonstrates complex tearing involving the free edge and the undersurface.

Intrasubstance degeneration in the anterior horn. 

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:  High-grade and full-thickness cartilage loss involving the central to posterior aspects of the femoral condyle and tibial plateau, with mild subchondral edema. Small central and marginal osteophytes. 

MEDIAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT:  Intact.

LATERAL COLLATERAL LIGAMENT COMPLEX:  Intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: Diffuse mild thinning of the patellar cartilage. There is high-grade and full-thickness cartilage loss throughout the trochlea, maximal centrally and laterally, with multifocal subchondral bone marrow edema. 

EXTENSOR APPARATUS:  Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. 

BONE MARROW:  No fracture. 
 
OTHER:  None. 


IMPRESSION:

1. Diminutive appearance of the posterior body and posterior horn of the lateral meniscus, suggestive of large radial tear in the absence of previous meniscectomy.

2. Moderate lateral and patellofemoral compartment osteoarthritis.

3. Moderate knee joint effusion and small popliteal cyst.

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı minimal artmış. Vastus medyalis kasının distalinde myotendinöz bileşkede hafif derecede kas zedelenmesi ve ilintili ödem gözleniyor. Bu düzeyin distalinde bütünlüğü büyük oranda korunmuş iç yan bağın çevresi ödemli; yüzeyel liflerinde parsiyel yırtık olabilir. Posteriyor oblik bağ (POL) olasılıkla parsiyel yırtık. Ön çapraz bağın tibyal insersiyonunda fokal parsiyel yırtık ve bağda ödem izleniyor. Meniskokapsüler bileşke posteromedyal köşede menisküse yakın kesimde ödemli; yırtık açısından şüpheli. Posteromedyal köşe yapıları bunların dışında normal. Arka çapraz ve dış yan bağlar normal. Lateral menisküs normal. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler lateral femoral kondilin posteriyorundaki subkondral kontüzyon dışında normal. Medyal patellar sinovyal plika eklem aralığına interpoze ancak kalınlığı normal. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

МР находка: Костите, формиращи дясната колянна  става са с нормална форма и структура. Вижда се контузионен костномозъчен едем в областта на латералния кондил на тибията. Няма данни за фрактура. Ставният хрущял е запазен. Наличие на малък ставен излив. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост, с непроменена сигнална характеристика. Нормално изобразяване на менискусите. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Ретинакулуми – нормално изобразяване. Колатерални лигаменти двустранно – б.о. Лигамент на пателата и сухожилие на м. квадрицепс фемрис – б.о. Поплитеална ямка – б.о. Едем в подкожието на коляното отзад, както и по хода на фасцията около м. бицепс феморис. Вижда се мултилокуларна ганглион киста дорзално от м. вастус медиалис на нивото на метафизата на фемура с общи размери в коронарната равнина 24/13мм. Заключение: Контузионен костномозъчен едем в областта на латералния кондил на тибията. Мултилокуларна ганглион киста зад м. вастус медиалис. Едемни промени в подкожието на коляното.

Knochen: Unauffälliges Knochenmarkssignal, kein Bone Bruise. MR-morphologisch kein Nachweis einer Sinterung oder Frakturlinie. Zentrierte Stellung femorotibial und femoro-patellar. Keine Osteophytenbildung.
Knorpel: Unauffälliger Knorpelbesatz im femoro-patellaren und femoro-tibialen Kompartiment.

The study reveals anterior tibial translation, no fracture detected.    
 Mild focal bone contusion at mid lateral femoral condyle, posterior lateral proximal tibia is noted.  
  There is abnormal ACL orientation with hyperintense disrupted proximal ACL part.  Mild buckling PCL with intact ligament fiber is observed.  
  
  Mild hyperintense superficial MCL is observed.    
    Oblique vertical tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus is detected.  
    
   Thickened  hyperintense proximal FCL and popliteus tendon are noted. The biceps femoris tendon is preserved.  
    Thinning relatively small size of posterior partposterior horn with longitudinal tear and displaced meniscal fragment located along posterior intercondylar fossa, suggesting bucket handle tear of the lateral meniscus.     
    
  The PF joint is preserved. No osteochondral lesion is detected.  
   Minimal joint effusion is observed.  
   Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.     Complete tear of ACL,   
     Bucket handle tear of the lateral meniscus 
     Oblique vertical tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus 
     Low grade partial tear proximal FCL and popliteus tendon, mild MCL sprain.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: One-week history knee pain status post fall.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Osseous contusion along the peripheral lateral femoral condyle, no superimposed fracture. Background marrow signal is otherwise normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild partial-thickness fissuring at the median ridge, no superimposed shearing injury/delamination. No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: High grade tearing involving the medial patellofemoral ligament at the femoral attachment with extensive surrounding soft tissue edema and blood products.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Findings compatible with recent transient patellar dislocation compatible characterized by moderate osseous contusion involving the peripheral lateral femoral condyle and high-grade tearing involving the MPFL at the femoral attachment.
2.	Mild patellofemoral compartment chondrosis, no superimposed posttraumatic shearing/delaminating defect.

In den vorliegenden Sequenzen unauffällige Signalgebung der ossären Strukturen, kein Knochenmarksödem, kein bone bruise. Keine wesentliche Chondropathie. Innen- sowie Außenmeniskus ohne Anhalt für eine Rissbildung. VKB sowie HKB intakt. MCL sowie LCL intakt. Kein Anhalt für ein Tractus iliotibialis-Syndrom. Deutlicher Kniegelenkserguss. Kleine Plica mediopatellaris. Quadriceps- sowie Patellarsehne mit intakter Signalgebung. Geringes inferopattelares, subkutanes Hämatom, ansonsten die miterfassten Weichteile in den vorliegenden Sequenzen mit unauffälliger Signalgebung.
